cast.name: Fire salamander
cast.note: Drenched by a second cold wave, dim and sagging, no longer charging; seems willing to yield.

choices: Strike it down while it's weak
Drive it away from the spring

image.prompt: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, wooden staff thrust forward, a crashing wave of cold water engulfing a huge ember-scaled salamander against a boulder, thick steam, dusk, red spring behind
image.fallback: A bowl of black rock with a glowing red spring, thick steam drifting in the dusk light, cracked ice on the ground.

answer.narration:
You stamp forward and swing the staff low. A second wave, colder than the first, crashes over the salamander and the boulder behind it. Steam bursts upward in a white wall, and the beast's howl cracks into a wheeze.

When the cloud thins, its scales are dull as old coals. It sags against the rock, ribs heaving, yellow eyes fixed on you. It doesn't charge. It only watches, wary and spent.
answer.summary: Mr Magic, a muscular fast-learning mage, found the red spring blocked by a giant ember-scaled salamander. His waves and ice have left it spent and dull against a boulder. Plan: defeat or calm the creature, free the spring, restore Karrowmere's water, conclude by turn 50.
